metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to delta.com, successfully entered SEA as origin and NYC as destination, but got stuck interacting with the date picker calendar widget. Spent all 50 turns unable to set correct departure/return dates. Repeatedly received 'please correct the 1 item indicated' validation error. Never clicked SEARCH, never reached flight results page.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome, type in text input fields, select from autocomplete dropdown suggestions, interact with web form checkboxes and buttons
metadata.failure_analysis: Model struggled with the delta.com date picker calendar widget. Could not properly select the 5th of next month as departure date. Kept toggling between months and dates without confirming. The complex calendar UI with month navigation proved too difficult.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original complex flight search into a simple Chrome settings navigation. Accessing settings tests basic Chrome navigation ability, a prerequisite for any complex browser task.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to chrome://settings. Evaluator uses active_url_from_accessTree to get the current URL and checks it matches the chrome://settings pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree address bar, with goto_prefix='chrome://' to prepend the correct protocol for internal Chrome pages.

Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict (with key 'expected') and uses re.search to match 'chrome://settings' against the extracted URL. This properly handles both exact matches and subpaths (e.g., chrome://settings/privacy).
The expected value 'chrome://settings' is semantically correct for verifying that Chrome's settings page is open.
Full instruction coverage: the single requirement ('Open Chrome's settings page') is fully verified by checking the active URL matches chrome://settings.
No postconfig needed since the settings page remains open as the active tab after the agent navigates to it.
